default.q: Is Credsey a bank or lender?
default.a: No. Credsey is a loan advisory and facilitation service. We compare offers from partner banks and NBFCs, help you choose, and manage the paperwork until disbursal. The lender makes the final credit decision.

default.q: Do you charge anything to apply?
default.a: Checking eligibility and speaking to an advisor are completely free. Lenders may charge a processing fee, which is always disclosed in your sanction letter. We never ask for upfront payments.

default.q: Will checking eligibility affect my credit score?
default.a: No. Our eligibility check uses a soft enquiry, which is not visible to lenders and doesn't affect your score. A hard enquiry happens only when you formally apply with a lender.

default.q: How long does it take to get a loan?
default.a: Personal and gold loans can be disbursed within 24 hours of approval. Home loans and loans against property usually take 7–15 working days because of the property checks.

default.q: Which documents will I need?
default.a: Usually PAN, Aadhaar, income proof (salary slips or ITR) and recent bank statements. Your advisor will share an exact checklist for your loan.

default.q: Is my information safe with Credsey?
default.a: Yes. Your data is encrypted in transit, shared only with the lenders you choose, and never sold. Read our privacy policy for details.

default.q: Fixed or floating rate — which is better?
default.a: Most home loans in India are floating and linked to the repo rate, so they fall when rates fall. Fixed rates offer certainty but are usually higher.

default.q: Can I transfer my existing home loan?
default.a: Yes. A balance transfer can lower your rate and also offer a top-up loan. Use our balance-transfer calculator to see the savings.

default.q: How much home loan can I get on a ₹50,000 salary?
default.a: With no other EMIs, lenders usually allow an EMI of about ₹25,000. At around 8.5% that supports roughly ₹28 lakh over 20 years or ₹32 lakh over 30 years.

default.q: Does a co-applicant increase home loan eligibility?
default.a: Yes. Adding an earning spouse or parent combines both incomes. If you are co-owners and co-borrowers, both can also claim tax benefits on the loan.

default.q: What are the home loan charges besides interest?
default.a: Expect a processing fee (often 0.25–1% of the loan), legal and valuation charges, and stamp duty on the loan agreement. Floating-rate home loans for individuals have no foreclosure charges.

default.q: How is EMI calculated?
default.a: EMI = P × r × (1 + r)^n / ((1 + r)^n − 1), where P is the principal, r is the monthly interest rate (annual rate ÷ 12 ÷ 100) and n is the tenure in months.

default.q: Does a longer tenure reduce EMI?
default.a: Yes, a longer tenure lowers the monthly EMI but increases the total interest you pay over the life of the loan.

default.q: Is the EMI the same every month?
default.a: For a fixed-rate loan, yes. For floating-rate loans the EMI or tenure can change when the lender revises its benchmark rate.

default.q: Why is most of my early EMI interest?
default.a: Interest is charged on the outstanding balance, which is highest at the start. As you repay, more of each EMI goes towards the principal.

label: Privacy Policy
default:
This policy explains how Credsey Financial Services ("Credsey", "we") collects, uses and protects your personal information when you use credsey.com.

Information we collect

  • Details you submit in our forms: name, mobile number, email, city, income, employment type and loan requirement.
  • Basic technical data such as browser type and pages visited, used to keep the site secure and improve it.

How we use it

  • To contact you about your enquiry and match you with suitable lenders.
  • To share your application with the banks or NBFCs you choose, solely to process your loan request.
  • To meet legal and regulatory obligations.

What we don't do

We do not sell your personal data. We never ask for your OTP, PIN, CVV or passwords.

Storage and security

Data is transmitted over encrypted (HTTPS) connections and stored with access restricted to authorised staff. We keep it only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law.

Your rights

label: Grievance Redressal
default:
We take every concern seriously and aim to resolve it quickly and fairly.

How to raise a grievance

  1. Submit your complaint through our contact page, mentioning "Grievance" with your name, mobile number and application details.
  2. We will acknowledge it within 2 working days.
  3. We aim to resolve it within 15 working days.

Complaints about a lender

If your concern is about a sanction, disbursal, charges or recovery by a bank or NBFC, we will help you escalate it to that lender's grievance officer. If it isn't resolved within 30 days, you can approach the RBI Integrated Ombudsman at cms.rbi.org.in.
